notes: Base game only; the game ends after the round in which someone has 12 cards in their tableau or the VP chips run out. Read from a university mirror of the rulebook PDF (not publisher-hosted). Player count 2 to 4 is inferred from the setup text, which gives start worlds and chip counts for 2, 3 and 4 players. Solo, expansions and the Jump Drive card game are excluded.
